predictive: Marker modifies treatment benefit compared with an appropriate alternative/control, ideally established by a prespecified biomarker-treatment interaction and independently validated.
prognostic: Marker associates with outcome regardless of treatment; a single treated cohort usually cannot separate this from prediction.
baseline_response_association: Pretreatment feature correlates with outcome among treated people; useful hypothesis but not automatically predictive.
pharmacodynamic: Feature changes after exposure; establishes biological effect or target engagement, not necessarily clinical benefit.
case_fit: Mechanistic consistency supports considering an option but is not a calibrated probability of response.
